messages:
Sam Chen: Hey team — quick heads up, I'm flying out for a family thing and need to hand off primary tonight. Flight leaves 22:30 PT. Can someone pick up primary from 23:00 - 07:00 PT? I can overlap 23:00-00:00 for a clean warm handoff.
Maria Gomez: I can do primary from 23:00-03:00 PT, then need to drop off for childcare. Who can cover 03:00-07:00?
Tariq Patel: I can take 03:00-07:00 PT. Do we want a shadow for the first hour of my shift in case of escalation?
Sam Chen: @Tariq thanks — yes please. @Joyce can you act as secondary/shadow 23:00-01:00 to help with any ongoing incidents?
Joyce Li: I can do 23:00-01:00 as shadow. Noted: I'll be reachable on phone +1-555-0199.
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Planned swap submitted by Sam Chen. Primary assignment update: Sam -> Maria (23:00), Maria -> Tariq (03:00). Shadow: Joyce (23:00-01:00).
incident-bot: :pager: Reminder: if an SEV routes, page both primary and secondary for first 20 minutes. See runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-escalation
Maria Gomez: Added a quick checklist for whoever takes primary. Paste into convo:```
- Check active alerts in /dash/infra
- Confirm model-serving pods healthy (kubectl get pods -n runtime)
- Check Redis KV cache hit rate > 85%
- If latency spike, cut to fallback model variant per runbook
```
Tariq Patel: Thanks for the checklist. One question — we had the KV cache regen last week, any ongoing background jobs that might spike at 00:30?
Sam Chen: Good catch. There is a nightly maintenance job at 00:15 that does small shard rebalances for embeddings refresh. It usually causes a ~3–5s tail latency in a subset of requests for ~8 minutes. Shouldn't page SEV by itself but watch latency.
Joyce Li: I'll keep an eye on latency charts between 00:00-01:00 and be ready to escalate. If we see >20% p95 increase route to oncall infra channel and page infra-eng.
Maria Gomez: Re: paging policy — confirm that primary gets SMS for any SEV2+? We should ensure Tariq's number is in PagerDuty.
Tariq Patel: I'm in PagerDuty, number on file. Also set my escalation window to 03:00-07:00.
Sam Chen: Final confirmation: Maria primary 23:00-03:00, Tariq primary 03:00-07:00, Joyce shadow 23:00-01:00. Overlap 23:00-00:00 with me for handoff. Anyone see a gap?
Maria Gomez: No gap from my side. I'll run through the canary checks at 23:05 and post results.
Joyce Li: I'll validate the token burn charts and redis hit rates during shadow.
incident-bot: :information_source: Auto-note: This thread was linked to the oncall rotation schedule and will be archived for audit.
Sam Chen: Thanks all — adding a tiny sticky: if you get a noisy burst from the embeddings job at 00:15, do not mass-restart pods. Instead: scale down the non-critical batch workers and enable partial-routing to fallback-model-v2. Steps in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-fallbacks#fallback-model-v2
Tariq Patel: Copy. I'll keep the ability to toggle partial-routing handy (`/scripts/route-fallback.sh --enable`).
Maria Gomez: Ping me 10m before handoff so I can annotate any in-flight tickets.
Sam Chen: Will do. Appreciate the coverage team :thumbsup:
Joyce Li: Good luck on the trip Sam! :airplane:
Maria Gomez: Confirmed handoff in calendar. I'll post a short status at 23:10.
Tariq Patel: Logged the swap in the oncall spreadsheet (link: https://docs.redwood/oncall/schedule).
Sam Chen: Closing the loop — I'll set an out-of-office note in Slack and PD, and leave my mobile on for urgent pages only.
Joyce Li: Acknowledged.
Maria Gomez: Acknowledged.
Tariq Patel: Acknowledged.
